name: minescript
description: MineScript – robotszimulátor webes játék (Dusza Árpád verseny, 2026/2027, I. forduló)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @minescript/shared && npm run build -w @minescript/server && npm run build -w @minescript/client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @minescript/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @minescript/server" "npm run dev -w @minescript/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @minescript/shared && npm run typecheck -w @minescript/server && npm run typecheck -w @minescript/client
scripts.db:init: npm run build -w @minescript/shared && npm run db:init -w @minescript/server
